verdict.rationale: Several hands-on reports describe kitty as very fast under heavy output: `tree` over a whole projects directory finishes lag-free, high-speed scrolling shows near-zero CPU, and it feels at least as fast as st. Other concrete reports contradict this: one user found cat-ting a long file about 100x slower than Terminal.app, another measured roughly 300ms input lag with fan spin-up, and one says it fails on many Nvidia laptops. No first-party doc in the pack describes the GPU rendering pipeline or its performance. missing for 10: first-party documentation of GPU-accelerated rendering and its performance characteristics, consistent independent benchmarks under heavy output, and resolution of the conflicting lag/slowness and GPU compatibility reports.
